event: Twelve-Day War begins
description: Israel launches strikes on Iran; Iran retaliates. Fighting lasts until a 24 June 2025 ceasefire.
market_note: Oil risk premium of ~$10-15/bbl built up then dissipated within days of the ceasefire (MCB Group, cited by Wikipedia).

event: Twelve-Day War ceasefire
description: US-brokered ceasefire ends the June 2025 Israel-Iran war.
market_note: Oil risk premium collapsed quickly after ceasefire; useful pre-war analogue.

event: Trump says US ready for deal with Iran
description: Trump states the US is ready to make a deal; Iran FM Araghchi says Iran would consider a fair proposal.
market_note: Low market impact; start of the pre-war negotiation track.

event: Nationwide anti-government protests erupt in Iran
description: Protests driven by economic decline and human-rights abuses spread nationwide from late December 2025.

event: Deadliest protest massacres (8 and 10 January)
description: Security forces kill large numbers of protesters; the deadliest incidents occur on 8 and 10 January 2026.
market_note: Raises US intervention rhetoric; geopolitical risk premium starts building.

event: Trump tells Iranians 'help is on its way'
description: Trump calls on Iranians to take over their institutions.

event: Trump announces 'massive Armada heading to Iran'
description: US naval buildup toward the Gulf announced publicly.
market_note: Defense stocks and oil watch; risk premium building.

event: IRGC gunboats attempt to seize US tanker in Hormuz
description: Six IRGC Navy gunboats try to stop and seize a US tanker in the Strait of Hormuz.

event: US-Iran indirect talks in Muscat
description: Indirect talks mediated by Oman's foreign minister.
market_note: Diplomatic hope; oil relatively calm (Brent ~$61 at prior year-end, ~$72 by late Feb).

event: Reports US could strike Iran within days
description: US warns Tehran to make a deal amid reports strikes are imminent.
market_note: Pre-war risk premium builds into oil.

event: State of the Union: Trump accuses Iran of reviving nuclear program
description: Trump calls Iran the world's number one sponsor of terror and accuses it of reviving nuclear-weapons efforts.

event: Operation Epic Fury authorized
description: Trump authorizes Operation Epic Fury; strikes begin within hours. Brent closes ~$72.48 on 28 Feb (last pre-war price).

event: War begins: US-Israeli strikes on Iran; Khamenei killed
description: Joint US-Israeli airstrikes on Iranian leadership and military infrastructure including a decapitation strike that killed Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei. Iran retaliates against Israel, Gulf states and US bases.
market_note: WAR_START anchor date. Iranian internet shut down.

event: Iranian retaliation on Israel and Gulf states; Hormuz traffic slows
description: Missile and drone strikes on Israel, Gulf states hosting US forces and US facilities; airspace closures; shipping through Hormuz slows sharply.
market_note: Gulf airlines grounded; KSE-100 largest ever single-day fall (-9.57%) on 2 Mar.

event: First trading day after strikes
description: Dow -400 pts, S&P 500 -0.7%, European/Asian indices -1 to -2%, gold up, airlines down (UAL -6%), USD up. Brent +10-13% to ~$80-82. Qatar halts all gas production after Iranian drone attack on Qatari gas facilities; European gas prices nearly double.
market_note: Brent ~$77-82 close; WTI ~$72.79; TTF spike; Hezbollah enters the war the same day.

event: Goldman estimates ~$14/bbl risk premium
description: Goldman Sachs estimates an approximately $14 per barrel risk premium under its disruption scenario. QatarEnergy declares force majeure.

event: Strait of Hormuz closed
description: Iran closes the Strait of Hormuz; oil and LNG exports stranded. KOSPI falls up to 12% and triggers circuit breaker; Thai exchange curbs trading. Asian LNG spot prices more than double to 3-year highs.
market_note: Brent surges past $120 (per Wikipedia economic impact); Asian equities crash.

event: Brent ~$83 in US session
description: Brent crude reported up 15% at $83/bbl by 5 March in US market transmission.
market_note: Source figures vary by venue; use market data for ground truth.

event: US Treasury waiver for India on Russian oil; Qatar force-majeure warning
description: US grants India a 30-day emergency waiver to buy stranded Russian oil; Qatar's al-Kaabi warns other Gulf producers may halt exports.
market_note: Policy responses to the energy shock begin.

event: Hormuz closure and global oil shock become dominant story
description: Oil moves above $100; Brent briefly approaches $120 and WTI above $100 in the 8-9 March escalation (CNN).

event: Gulf oil output down 6.7 mb/d
description: Kuwait, Iraq, Saudi and UAE production collectively down a reported 6.7 million bbl/day by 10 March; at least 10 mb/d by 12 March.

event: Baghdad Green Zone drone strike; Kata'ib Hezbollah commander killed
description: Airstrike kills Abu Ali al-Askari in Baghdad; Al Rasheed hotel hit by drone while hosting EU and Saudi delegation.

event: Israel expands operations into southern Lebanon; NATO refuses Hormuz mission
description: Israel expands ground operations in Lebanon. China and European NATO nations reject Trump's call to help reopen Hormuz.

event: Israel strikes South Pars gas field; Iran hits Ras Laffan LNG
description: Israel strikes Iran's South Pars gas field; Iran retaliates against Qatar's Ras Laffan LNG complex cutting Qatar LNG capacity 17% (3-5 years to repair). Asian LNG spot prices +140%.
market_note: LNG/gas shock; helium supply shock (Qatar ~35% of global helium).

event: ECB postpones rate cuts; Haifa BAZAN refinery hit
description: ECB postpones planned rate reductions and raises 2026 inflation forecast. Iranian missile attack hits BAZAN refinery in Haifa.

event: Fertilizer prices up to +40% since war start
description: Fertilizer prices rose up to 40% from war start to 20 March; ~50% of global urea and sulfur exports transit Hormuz.

event: US strikes Natanz with bunker busters
description: US strikes the Natanz nuclear facility; Russia condemns; IAEA warns of nuclear accident risk.

event: Trump postpones attacks for talks; suspicious pre-announcement oil shorts
description: Trump statement postponing attacks for talks causes oil to fall; FT later finds $580M bets on falling oil placed 15 minutes before.
market_note: Oil down sharply intraday; insider-trading suspicion.

event: 10-year Treasury yield hits 4.46%; Brent $112.57
description: 10y yield highest since July 2025; 30y mortgage 6.38% on 26 Mar. Brent at $112.57 (+55% since 28 Feb). Iranian strike damages US aircraft at Prince Sultan Air Base.
market_note: Rates and oil both at war highs.

event: Iran hits Emirates Global Aluminium; strikes on Iranian universities
description: Iran strikes Emirates Global Aluminium causing production disruptions (aluminum +8% in March); US-Israeli strikes damage Iran University of Science and Technology.
market_note: Metals channel: aluminum, tungsten (+50% in March), sulfur, helium.

event: S&P 500 trough at 6316.91; Trump threatens Iranian power plants and desalination
description: S&P 500 closes 6316.91 (later +17.3% by 24 July). Trump threatens to strike all Iranian power plants, oil wells, Kharg Island and desalination plants if Hormuz not reopened.
market_note: Equity low of the war; peak fear.

event: Brent peak $118.35
description: Brent closes at its war peak of $118.35; US gasoline hits $4/gal (+30%).

event: US strikes collapse B1 bridge near Tehran
description: Two US strikes collapse the Tehran-Karaj B1 bridge; 8 killed.

event: Iran shoots down US F-15E
description: First US fighter shot down by Iran in 20+ years; crew rescued.

event: Explosions at Bushehr nuclear plant and Mahshahr petrochemical zone
description: Airstrikes hit Bushehr auxiliary building and Mahshahr Special Petrochemical Zone (5 killed, 170 injured).

event: Two-week ceasefire announced (Pakistan-mediated 10-point plan)
description: Trump announces US-Iran agreement on a Pakistan-mediated plan; two-week ceasefire under which Iran would reopen Hormuz. FT later reports $950M oil shorts placed shortly before.
market_note: Oil falls sharply; CEASEFIRE anchor date (effective 8 April).

event: Ceasefire begins
description: Two-week ceasefire takes effect but deteriorates quickly.

event: Islamabad talks fail; US begins 'clearing' Hormuz
description: High-level Islamabad talks end without a deal; Trump says US forces started clearing the strait.

event: US announces naval blockade of Hormuz / Iranian ports
description: US announces reciprocal naval blockade.

event: Israel-Lebanon ten-day truce; Iran allows commercial passage during truce
description: Trump announces Israel-Lebanon truce; Iran says commercial vessels may pass during the truce but US blockade continues and Iran re-imposes restrictions.

event: Iran FM says Hormuz open for rest of ceasefire; suspicious Brent shorts
description: 7,990 Brent futures lots (~$750M) sold 20 minutes before the announcement.

event: Vitol: 600-700M barrels lost so far
description: Vitol CEO says ~1 billion barrels of production will be lost due to the war.

event: Spirit Airlines ceases operations
description: Fuel costs from the war exacerbate existing financial difficulties.

event: IDF strikes Tehran Isfahan Tabriz; renewed exchange
description: Israel strikes military sites in Iran triggering an exchange of fire.

event: US-Iran agreement to end war and reopen Hormuz announced
description: Draft deal: Iran agrees not to produce nuclear weapons; HEU diluted in Iran. Memorandum digitally signed 14 June (announced by Vance 15 June).
market_note: Oil falls, agricultural stocks rise (TIME). PEACE_DEAL anchor date.

event: Islamabad Memorandum signed by Trump and Pezeshkian
description: Signed after the G7 summit at Versailles.

event: US lifts blockade; Hormuz reopens
description: CENTCOM removes naval blockade; Pakistan says Tehran will reopen Hormuz instantly.
market_note: HORMUZ_REOPEN anchor date; shipping normalises briefly.

event: Renewed Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire then fighting (19-20 June)
description: Trump announces renewed Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire; Hezbollah attacks Israeli forces on 20 June; Iran reportedly re-closes Hormuz temporarily.

event: US-Iran peace talks begin in Switzerland
description: Talks open; Qatar and Pakistan describe a roadmap; US Treasury issues 60-day license waiving sanctions on Iranian oil (22 June).

event: Brent trough $71.57
description: Brent falls to $71.57 after the peace memorandum, roughly back to pre-war level.

event: Iran attacks commercial vessels; Trump declares MOU 'over'
description: Iran attacks commercial vessels in Hormuz to assert sovereignty; Trump says the memorandum is over.

event: US to reinstate Iranian blockade and 20% Hormuz toll
description: Trump announces reinstating the blockade and a 20% cargo toll (toll cancelled 14 July).

event: Brent $100.69 then $96.78 on 24 July
description: Renewed tension pushes Brent back above $100; S&P 500 at 7411.98 on 24 July (+17.3% from 30 March).
market_note: Oil shipping index down from 3,737 (Mar) to 1,850 (Jul).

event: Iranian cyberattacks on US water systems reported; new base damage
description: NYT reports evidence linking Iran to cyberattacks on water systems in 7+ US states; BBC Verify finds damage to nine US bases 12 Jul-1 Aug.

event: Trump calls off massive strikes after Qatari/Saudi intervention
description: Trump says he and Israel called off attacks after Iran requested more time.

event: Iran attacks ADNOC tanker in Hormuz
description: UAE says Iran attacked an ADNOC tanker; IRGC says reopening depends on US accepting Iran's conditions.

event: Iran fires missiles toward UAE; UAE halts all trade with Iran
description: UAE halts trade, exchange and financial transactions with Iran.

event: 'Economic D-day': secondary sanctions on any nation trading with Iran
description: Trump announces sanctions on any nation trading with Iran.

event: US confirms mines cleared from Hormuz traffic separation scheme
description: Underwater drones identified 100+ suspected mines which were removed.
market_note: Shipping risk declining; Kpler confirms declining Iranian control 27 Aug.

event: Iran-Oman agreement on Hormuz control and revenue
description: IRGC announces agreements with Oman.

event: US strikes Larak Island launchers
description: US targets IRGC launchers preparing sea-mine rockets; Iran retaliates 31 Aug.

event: 'Tanker for tanker' policy: US strikes NIOC tankers
description: Tanker hit by three projectiles leaving Hormuz; US strikes IRGC targets and NIOC tankers.

event: US destroys three IRGC-linked tankers; Iran fires on US warships
description: IRGC targets three unauthorised tankers; ballistic missiles at US vessels.

event: US destroys five Iranian tankers; Jordan intercepts 18 of 20 Iranian missiles
Iran rejects negotiations until demands met; House votes to end war
description: US House votes for a third time to end the war after CBO warns cost >= $38B and ~$3B/month.

event: CENTCOM: >1 billion barrels exited Gulf via Hormuz in recent months
description: Adm. Brad Cooper statement.
